source_text: Women unaffected by female genital cutting are females who have not undergone the culturally motivated procedure involving partial or total removal of, or other injury to, the external female genitalia, a practice that spares the natural anatomy and avoids procedure-linked complications such as hemorrhage, chronic pain, urinary issues, sexual dysfunction, and increased childbirth risks. [1]
